name: flow-password-strength
title: Password Strength
description: Gõ mật khẩu, bốn vạch sáng lần lượt theo số điều kiện đạt, nhãn đổi từ YẾU tới MẠNH, danh sách điều kiện tích dần; đủ bốn thì cả thanh chuyển xanh.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio password-strength, written here): Password field 176x36: a dot appears every 0.16 s from 0.3 s (13 max), caret blinks. 4 segments 40x8 r4 (44 px pitch) light at 0.5 / 1.1 / 1.7 / 2.3 s: scaleX 0.6 → 1 and scaleY on spring k420 c16 (overshoot); accent, all green at 4/4. Label WEAK → FAIR → GOOD → STRONG: each fades in 0.07-0.17 s after its event rising 5 px, the previous fades out 0.07 s. Rule list at right: circle checks pop on the same spring at the same times. Reset 3.25-3.5 s. Params: events ([0.5, 1.1, 1.7, 2.3] s) · segments (4 × 40x8) · pop (k420 c16) · labels (WEAK → STRONG). Each segment and rule check pops on a spring k420 c16; all segments turn green at four of four.
